description: Apply a real 3×3 emboss convolution kernel for a raised, carved look.

faqs.a: A 3×3 emboss kernel ([-2,-1,0],[-1,1,1],[0,1,2]) with a 128 grey offset, computed pixel by pixel.
faqs.q: How is the emboss effect computed?

faqs.a: Yes — embossing works best on photos with clear shapes and good contrast.
faqs.q: Does it work on any photo?

faqs.a: A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
